create.name: Alexis Cohen
create.bio:
Alexis Cohen is an American visionary artist, shamanic practitioner and film producer, and the founder of Art Medicine, a creative path that treats painting as a form of prayer and a doorway to Spirit. Before turning to art full time she worked for ten years as a birth doula, attending around 300 births, and she draws on that experience of holding space through big transitions in her teaching. Art Medicine began in 2016, when painting a large mural of a Goddess during a period of upheaval in her own life opened what she describes as an inner channel of listening.

She teaches intuitive painting, which she calls portal painting, combined with guided meditation, shamanic journeying and ritual. Her self-paced journeys and workshops work with themes such as light codes, the elements, spirit allies and abundance, and she runs the Art Medicine Practitioner Certification for artists and healers who want to guide others. She also co-leads a creative-project accelerator with her husband, the writer and director Brent Bishop, with whom she is producing a feature film. She has spoken on many online summits and podcasts and offers a free eleven-day practice called Painted Prayer.

courses.title: Art Medicine Practitioner Certification
courses.description: A certification and mentoring programme for artists, healers and guides who want to lead others through intuitive, intention-based art-making. It blends intuitive painting, energy work and ritual. Enrolment is currently closed, with a waitlist for the next intake.

courses.title: Creating with Light
courses.description: A self-paced four-part Art Medicine bundle working with beings of the light realms. Through guided practice and painting, students learn to hold and express light frequencies in their creative work.

courses.title: Winged Friends
courses.description: A self-paced three-part bundle for people feeling a creative calling. Guided journeys with the Butterfly People, the Angels of Atlantis and the Wise Owls lead into intuitive painting.

courses.title: Creating with the Elements
courses.description: A self-paced four-part bundle on the elements of Fire, Water, Air and Earth. Each part combines a shamanic journey with Art Medicine practices and intuitive art-making to help bring creative ideas into form.

courses.title: Wealth Activation through Art
courses.description: A self-paced creative journey on abundance for artists, healers and lightworkers. It includes meeting a spirit guide of prosperity, a workbook on money stories, a guided painting process and a daily meditation.

courses.title: The Creator's Roadmap
courses.description: A five-week accelerator, led by Alexis Cohen and Brent Bishop, on planning, funding and launching a creative project. It covers vision, team building, budgets and timelines, funding and sales, with templates and an organisation kit.

courses.title: Paint Light Codes
courses.description: A recorded workshop on channelling personal power symbols through painting. Students create their own light-code artwork as an ongoing practice for awareness.

courses.title: Paint Your Path to Higher Consciousness
courses.description: A pre-recorded two-hour workshop using colour, symbol and intuitive painting as a gateway to wider awareness. It ends with a finished Art Medicine piece to keep working with.

courses.title: Mother's Magic Painting
courses.description: A guided painting journey with Alexis and her mother, Stephanie, honouring motherhood, lineage and mother figures. It can be painted alone or with a loved one and comes with a workbook of reflections.

free_resources.title: Painted Prayer
free_resources.description: A free eleven-day creative and devotional practice that uses simple painting as prayer. It is designed to help reconnect with a sense of creative purpose.

flags: Her method is named 'Art Medicine' and the certification page says making art 'makes you healthy' and that not making art can cause 'Dis-Ease'; it is not a medical modality and the descriptions here make no health claims, but a human may want to review the name.

All store prices are hidden behind Kajabi checkout pages that returned 403 (Cloudflare) to curl and WebFetch, so every offering is 'Contact for pricing'; the URLs used are /offers/<id>, which redirect to checkout.
Art Medicine Practitioner Certification is closed with a waitlist; kept as her main ongoing programme.
Painted Prayer is free but delivered through a Kajabi checkout with a free coupon (email needed).
Seven of the nine videos are interviews on other people's channels where she is the main guest; her own channel has only three old videos (one a 3-hour panel, left out).
Second photo is a cut-out from her website with a painted gold background, from the same shoot as the Shift photo.
The Shift bio names her husband only as 'Brent', a writer and director; 'Brent Bishop' comes from her store, where he co-leads The Creator's Roadmap. That they are the same person is inferred.
A different Alexis Cohen (American Idol singer, anxiety-clinic staff) appears in YouTube results; none of those videos were used.
left_out: Healing through the Holidays bundle: seasonal, and framed around inner healing and calming the nervous system (borderline).
Creative Empowerment Council (3-hour panel on her channel, starts at minute 10): panel, not her teaching.
Crystals & Color - Art Medicine Festival (ShamaMama channel): could not confirm she is the main speaker.
Interviews 'Art as Medicine' with Dr Judith Rich (2:50 clip) and with Beth Weinstein (31 views, 'Medicine For These Times'): short or unclear.
Art Medicine Festival (free online festival): dated past editions (2022, 2024).
Shift Network 'New Program With Alexis Cohen' (begins March 2027): no title or own URL yet.
